pages.text:
Day 1: quiet. Replaced Aldric on the south road. Nothing moves.
Day 3: the sound from the stone changed before dawn. Reported to the ward. No response.
Day 4: Aldric has not returned from the heath. His post is empty.
Day 7: something is wrong with the world above. I can hear the keth at night now. It speaks.
I am not leaving my post.
